review.why: Decides when an n8n workflow really needs a Code node instead of an expression or Edit Fields, and shows the patterns that justify one.
review.summary: Treats the Code node as a last resort with a decision order: expression, then arrow function in Edit Fields, then Code. It shows expression replacements for common code, names the valid cases (multi-source aggregation, libraries), warns to use the native Crypto and XML nodes, and explains run-once-for-all-items mode. Pattern and tree details are in three references.
strengths: Concrete wrong-versus-right examples for crypto and XML
Simple quick tests for whether code is needed
Defaults to JavaScript unless the user asks for Python
cautions: Performance figures are anecdotal, as it says
Reference files are not read here
